text: My daily routine starts early. I usually wake up at seven o'clock and drink a glass of water before breakfast. After that, I get ready and start work at nine. I work until five, with a short break for lunch around midday. In the afternoon, I often go for a run or do some exercise at the gym. In the evening, I cook dinner and relax by watching TV or reading a book. I try to go to bed before eleven. Staying consistent with my routine helps me feel organised and healthy.
